name: Depaato
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood department store (Nijiiro Depaato): a notice about an elevator inspection, a first day helping at the information desk, a usage guide, a notice about a new loyalty-club discount day, a membership guide, a reflection on talking with a customer about choosing gifts, a report on teaching a new part-time staff member how to gift-wrap, an essay on why visitor numbers grew, a year-end and New Year business guide, a column on how the role of department stores has changed, a notice of revised membership rules, a reflection on the meaning carried in wrapping paper, and a one-year cooperation report on joint events with the local shopping street. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
